question: The three canonical gate negatives whose only stage-B rejection was the frozen R03 false positive (m13, m18, m31) become stage-B accepts under BOTH repairs. Does the canonical structural gate (stage A) still reject them, so the two-stage pipeline does not lose the catch?
conclusion: All three remain rejected by stage A (R12 / R06 / R22); the union pipeline keeps the catch. The stage-B change is therefore not a file-level gate-negative regression.
